entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Sorry to contact you so late[n]at night, but I have a message[n]from my sister.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I will try to keep this short,[n]but the police apparently have[n]their eyes on us.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: So, it might be best to avoid[n]getting together until you[n]get back, [fName].

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Let's pass on Christmas[n]tomorrow, just in case.[n]It's really too bad...
